title: Arclet
tagline: Arclet is an agentic wallet that turns natural-language trading intents into onchain execution
description: Arclet is an agentic wallet on Arc that turns natural-language trading instructions into structured, autonomous onchain actions. Users define intents like “buy cirBTC when BTC drops 4%, but keep at least 1,000 USDC liquid.” Arclet monitors live blockchain data, evaluates the strategy, and executes only when the user’s approved rules are satisfied.
how_its_made: Arclet is built with Next.js, TypeScript, Bun, Tailwind, Drizzle, Postgres, Privy, Circle Agent Stack, Arc, The Graph, and a provider-agnostic LLM layer supporting cheap models like Qwen3. The Graph provides live market signals, the LLM converts intents into structured strategies, and deterministic TypeScript checks enforce limits before Circle executes USDC-based actions on Arc.
